items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I know when Punch and I, Punch and them started playing music

ctx.x: Freddie Keppert. Do you remember anything about his playing or anything about his band or anything like that?

Oh, I don't know who he, I forgot who he had in his band. I don't remember him so good. I remember him playing at the Corporator's Hall, but I know when Punch and I, Punch and them started playing music, well they used to have all that Punch and.
How was Punch in those days? How did he sound? Was he popular? Yeah, he was popular.
